title: Spreading an isomorphism of two lines from a projective-bundle fibre
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], E a quasi-coherent finite locally free module of constant rank r >= 2 [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module], and p:P(E)->S its canonical symmetric-algebra relative Proj [def-trf-canonical-symmetric-graded-algebra]. Let M,N be invertible modules on P(E) [def-sc-invertible-module]. Fix s in S, with fibre inclusion i_s:P(E)_s->P(E) [def-pc-scheme-fibre]. If i_s^*M is isomorphic to i_s^*N, then there is an open neighbourhood U of s such that M and N have isomorphic restrictions to p^{-1}(U), with pullback as in [def-pc-module-pullback]. No extension of a prescribed isomorphism is required, and no tautological quotient or degree appears.

source.place: Remark 4.2.7, fibre generator lifting and proper shrinking; Stacks coherent.tex Tag 07VK and limits.tex Tag 0B8W for arbitrary-base approximation.

proof.text: Use finite locally free generators to exhibit E as finite type. Present the canonical projection as the identity closed immersion into its own symmetric-algebra relative Proj, and apply projective-bundle properness. Lift the fibre isomorphism to a morphism phi above an open U using fibre homomorphism lifting.

source.place: Remark 4.2.7, fibre generator lifting and proper shrinking; Stacks coherent.tex Tag 07VK and limits.tex Tag 0B8W for arbitrary-base approximation.

proof.text: Tensor-formula pullback agrees with ordinary module pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints, so the restrictions of M,N remain invertible and finite locally free. Fibrewise invertibility of phi puts the image of the fibre inclusion inside the open O=moduleMapIsoLocus(phi). Properness of the restricted projection f makes f(X_U minus O) closed. Its complement W contains s, since range(fibre inclusion)=f inverse image of {s}. View W as a base open V contained in U. Every point over V lies in O, by construction of W.

source.place: Remark 4.2.7, fibre generator lifting and proper shrinking; Stacks coherent.tex Tag 07VK and limits.tex Tag 0B8W for arbitrary-base approximation.

proof.text: The inclusion g:p^{-1}(V)->p^{-1}(U) has range contained in O, so the iso-locus pullback lemma makes g^*phi invertible. The tensor pullback composition isomorphism identifies its source and target with the restrictions of M,N to p^{-1}(V). Compose those comparison isomorphisms with asIso(g^*phi). This yields the required isomorphism on the neighbourhood V of s.

source.place: Remark 4.2.7, fibre generator lifting and proper shrinking; Stacks coherent.tex Tag 07VK and limits.tex Tag 0B8W for arbitrary-base approximation.

mathlib_searches.query: Invertible modules on projective space over a field are uniquely tensor powers of O(1); two invertible sheaves isomorphic on a fibre are isomorphic over a neighbourhood
mathlib_searches.results: Field query: 8 hits, including CommRing.Pic.mk_eq_one_iff and Module.Invertible.instProjective; no projective-space Picard theorem. Spreading query: 8 hits, including Proj.ext, Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_of_iso, and topological vector-bundle trivializations; none is a spreading theorem for algebraic lines.

mathlib_searches.query: Every invertible sheaf on projective space over a field is a unique integer twist and locally over any base is a twist; two line bundles on projective space over an arbitrary base which agree on a fiber become isomorphic above a neighborhood

mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib msearch: 3 unrelated hits. Repository search: proved ProjectiveLine.existsUnique_degree_of_isInvertible covers only dimension one. AffineSpaceInvertibleTrivial proves chart triviality; ProperFlatFibreSectionLifting lifts sections under explicit hypotheses. from.place: Local-normal-form proof steps 3-4 applied to M dual tensor N with trivial fibre, without classifying any degree.

theorem projective_bundle_fiber_iso_spread (S : Scheme.{u}) (E : S.Modules)
    [E.IsQuasicoherent] (r : ℕ)
    [SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} E r] (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (M N : (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProj.Modules)
    (hM : M.IsInvertible) (hN : N.IsInvertible) (s : S)
    (e : Nonempty
      ((tensorPullback
        ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom.fiberι s)).obj M ≅
        (tensorPullback
          ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom.fiberι s)).obj N)) :
    ∃ U : S.Opens, s ∈ U ∧ Nonempty
      ((tensorPullback
        ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj M ≅
        (tensorPullback
          ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj N)
